## Design

### 2026-10-25 – I've spent a lot of time researching how MIDI controllers work and the best way to assemble them. I was thinking of using perf board for my project but because the cherry MX switches are a weird dimen

**2h**

I've spent a lot of time researching how MIDI controllers work and the best way to assemble them. I was thinking of using perf board for my project but because the cherry MX switches are a weird dimension I am switching to making a custom PCB.

I am going to start with just 1 board with 10 total keys because that is a nice number for most packages. Or I might do 12 if I can find some for cheap.

I plan to have the main keys be a separate board from the ESP32 which will be in charge of sending MIDI signals to my computer to be processed. This way I can always add more keys later.

The keys will be laid out in a matrix so I can use less GIOP pins. There will be a diode for each switch to prevent ghosting.

Tomorrow is the last day this week and I will have to spend a lot of time finalizing things because I have been busy with real life stuff this week. I still need to decide if I want to add LEDs in or just keep it simpler.
